WITH calendar AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_sales_by_day AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           c.d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN calendar c
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = c.d_date_sk
     AND ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, c.d_date
),
store_sales_by_day AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           c.d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN calendar c
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = c.d_date_sk
     AND ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, c.d_date
),
web_cume AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales_by_day
),
store_cume AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales_by_day
),
combined_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT w.item_sk,
           w.d_date,
           w.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           s.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_cume w
    LEFT JOIN store_cume s
      ON w.item_sk = s.item_sk
     AND w.d_date = s.d_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.item_sk,
           s.d_date,
           NULL::numeric AS web_sales,
           s.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM store_cume s
    LEFT JOIN web_cume w
      ON s.item_sk = w.item_sk
     AND s.d_date = w.d_date
    WHERE w.item_sk IS NULL
),
with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_sales,
           store_sales,
           MAX(web_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(store_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM combined_rows
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM with_cumulative
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
